intro: Barithras Moonshade is a night elf resident of Auberdine in Darkshore. Positioned within the coastal settlement, he seeks the help of adventurers willing to explore the shadowy wilderness and gather rare subterranean flora.

p: Standing watch within the village of Auberdine, Barithras Moonshade contributes to the night elves' efforts to study and manage the unsettled land of Darkshore. He directs travelers to venture into nearby subterranean caverns to harvest specific fungi, such as death cap mushrooms, for study and use.

Beyond local flora, Barithras assists in guiding capable adventurers southward to make contact with Onu, one of the venerable ancients striving to heal Darkshore's tainted soil and soothe its restless natural spirits.
